title: Nathan Thomas Becomes World's Youngest Male Professor at Age 18
summary: Nathan Thomas Becomes World's Youngest Male Professor at Age 18

items: Nathan Thomas (18 yrs 346 days) became world's youngest male professor in Florida, US, breaking a 300-year-old Guinness record.
